## GrowAssistant – Crop Steering v0.1.13

This release improves number entity editing throughout the GrowAssistant integration.

### Numeric input fields

- All GrowAssistant integration-managed number entities now render as direct numeric input fields.
- Sliders were replaced with `NumberMode.BOX` (BOX mode).
- This applies globally to all current and future integration-managed number entities.

### Compatibility

No entity IDs, unique IDs, values, minimum or maximum values, steps, units, crop steering logic, Blueprint logic, or pump control were changed.
